eyebrow: Account keys: a bearer token, not a scoped grant
code:
Primary/secondary keys (read-write + read-only)
-> full access to EVERY database/container
-> no per-container scoping

Risk: a key hardcoded in a mobile app
can be extracted by decompiling it.
A key committed to source control
stays exposed even after reverting.
caption: Keys are appropriate for trusted backend services in Key Vault — never client devices.
